root.label: Kiley requests DOJ and Treasury investigation of youth sports gambling

events.label: Kiley requests DOJ and Treasury investigation of youth sports gambling

slots.name: request date
slots.sentence: Rep. Kevin Kiley, a California independent who chairs a Congressional subcommittee that has held hearings about private equity’s affect in youth sports, has written a letter to U.S. Attorney General Todd Blanch and U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent to request an inquiry into gambling on the Little League World Series.
